title: infraharvest catalogue file
description: What infraharvest knows about some of a Terraform provider's resource types. See docs/catalogue.md.

provider.description: The Terraform provider's local name, such as aws or google.

service.description: The infraharvest service that lists the file's types, unless an entry names another.

types.description: Entries by Terraform resource type; "*" holds the omit and state_only of every type.

template.description: An import ID template: text and fields in braces, {id} for the lister's ID or {<attribute>}, with filters such as {id|after_last:/}.

service.description: The infraharvest service that lists the type.

import_id.description: Builds the import ID: the first template whose fields all have values.

not_importable.description: Why Terraform can't import the type.

omit.description: Arguments to leave out of generated configuration: name, whatever its value, or name=value, only where it is set to value.

state_only.description: Arguments the provider keeps only in state, which an import leaves unset.

skip.description: Resources the default selection leaves out: all the conditions a rule sets must hold.

children.description: Types of the separate resources that hold parts of a resource's configuration.

placeholder.description: Placeholders for arguments Terraform can't read back, such as where a function's code comes from, set when the generated configuration has none of one_of, and ignored.

data_source.description: The data source that reads one resource by its import ID.

arn.description: An AWS ARN's service and the resource type its resource part starts with.

cloud_control.description: The CloudFormation type Cloud Control lists the type as, and its identifier's property.

inventory.description: The cloud's inventory API's type for resources of this type (Cloud Asset Inventory, Resource Graph), and the pattern of their names when that type covers several: * is one segment between slashes.
